correct.evidence: Finding 1 (blocking): a first add whose only file is skipped (empty, a folder, over 50 MiB) or whose first index save fails leaves keys.bin without documents.bin, and every documents call after a relaunch is index_missing. Finding 3: store_full at 4999 plus a duplicate. All first-review inputs P1 to P7 now answer right.

sourced.evidence: The limits 50, 5000, 20000 and 200 equal the maxItems of contracts/desktop_documents_bridge.schema.json at 2d46965 and are marked as D96's; 50 MiB and the chunk and nonce layout unchanged from specs/documents-1/SPEC.md lines 92, 142, 175.

never_assumes.evidence: A missing index with files present is refused and nothing is deleted (P3: 2 files before, 2 after). Finding 1 asserts a lost index where none existed, a refusal rather than a quiet answer.

inside_the_boundary.evidence: No new words a person reads; refusals are codes; Notifications carry the saved title and body only; copy lint exit 0.

secure.evidence: No path, key or chunk fault gets through; export into the data folder, files/ or a zip there is refused. Finding 2: reminders-shown.json is unsalted sha256 of id and date, reversed in a millisecond, and survives state.clear. Note 6: a folder named x.json in published gives 500.

tested.evidence: Finding 1 has no test. Mutants N1b, N1c and N4c survive (finding 4). M1, M2, M3, M6, M13, M17 are now caught by review_w2p4_6 and review_w2p4_7.

findings.title: A first add that stores nothing locks Documents as index_missing after the next launch
findings.input: New data folder; add([an empty file]) (or a folder, or a 60 MiB file, or the first documents.bin write failing); then openStore again and list, add
findings.what_happens: The add answers ok with the file skipped, but load(true) already wrote keys.bin and no index is ever saved. After relaunch list and add are refused index_missing for good; only Delete everything recovers. No test covers keys.bin alone.

findings.title: reminders-shown.json reveals reminder dates that state.bin encrypts, and outlasts state.clear
findings.input: Reminder loop.b on 2026-10-07 shown; read <userData>/reminders-shown.json from a copy of the data folder
findings.what_happens: The file is plaintext unsalted sha256('<id> <date>'); trying 3 ids over 4 years recovered 'loop.b 2026-10-07'. After set(null) the file remains.

findings.title: store_full is refused before the store holds 5000
findings.input: 4999 documents held; add([new.pdf, duplicate of a held file])
findings.what_happens: Refused store_full, though only one would be stored; the contract says store_full means the store already holds 5000.

findings.title: Each half of index_missing and the update path of the 200-version cap are untested
findings.input: Mutants N1b (only keys.bin checked), N1c (only files/ checked), N4c (versions above id counted as 1, line 501)

findings.title: The multi-file replaces rule is in two places; unreachable throws after infinite generators
findings.input: Mutants N6 and N6b each survive alone; N6c caught
findings.what_happens: docbridge.ts:207 and docstore.ts:348 guard the same input; docbridge.ts:101 and 111 throw lines are unreachable.

findings.title: A folder named x.json in pipeline/published gives 500
findings.what_happens: published_updates raises IsADirectoryError; catching OSError too would skip it.

findings.title: build-python.sh here-string needs a temp file
findings.input: Run the buildpython tests where bash 3.2 cannot write its here-document temp file
findings.what_happens: 3 buildpython tests fail in the reviewer sandbox only; with process substitution all 7 pass.

findings.title: An index over 20000 lines from the pre-fix build answers list only after the next write
findings.input: documents.bin holding 20001 history lines, then documents.list
findings.what_happens: list is rejected as outside the contract until one update trims the history to 20000.
